title: BT39008: Bioinformatics Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Understanding databases, understanding NCBI Entrez, Pairwise alignment and
multiple alignment, BLAST analysis of nucleotide and protein sequences, Gene
finding (Genescan, ORF finder, Translation etc.), Sequence analysis
(restriction map, repeat sequence identification, secondary structure
prediction etc.), Primer design for PCR, Genome analysis (ongoing and completed
genome), Phylogenetic tree constructions, protein structure prediction and
functional analysis.
